name: vlm_grounding
description: Open-vocabulary pixel segmentation using a real pretrained model (CLIPSeg, via transformers). Given an image and a free-text description, produces a binary mask via genuine model inference rather than keyword-to-class lookup. Base checkpoint is trained on natural photos, not remote sensing, so masks on overhead content are out-of-distribution guesses, not measurements, UNLESS a LoRA adapter has been trained (see training/finetune_grounding_lora.py) and AETHERIS_GROUNDING_LORA_PATH points at it -- none ships by default. Requires the optional 'vlm' extra (torch + transformers); refuses via analysis_unavailable if unavailable.

image_path.description: Path to the input satellite image

text_prompt.description: Free-text description of the region to segment (e.g. 'water bodies', 'built-up area')

return_bbox.description: Also return a bounding box around the mask

mask_path.description: Path to the output binary mask (PNG)

bbox.description: Bounding box [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in pixel coordinates

mask_area_px.description: Number of positive pixels in the mask

confidence.description: Mean sigmoid probability inside the predicted mask, from the model's own output
